summary: Verified bug fix on /profile/{student_id}: public profile now returns ALL submissions (no status/verified filter) for the demo student, and PublicProfile.jsx renders every submission as a card with category tag, status badge, title, org and a Verified badge only when verified=true. Backend pytest suite expanded with a dedicated regression test asserting the 'Submitted' status is now present in the public response. All 25 backend tests pass. Frontend Playwright test confirms 8 cards rendered for the demo student with the required data-testid attributes; previously these 'Submitted' submissions were hidden.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py public_profile correctly drops the prior status/verified $or filter and enriches each submission with challenge_category via a single batched query on challenges collection (good - no N+1).

PublicProfile.jsx uses data-testid on every interactive/informational element required by the spec (completed-{id}, completed-title-{id}, completed-org-{id}, category-tag-{id}, status-badge-{id}, verified-badge-{id}). Verified badge is conditionally rendered only when s.verified is true - correct.
Submissions are sorted by submitted_at desc on the backend; assertion added to test.

seed_data_creation: No new seed data created in this iteration. Used existing demo student submissions (6-8 TEST_pending_* submissions with mixed Submitted/Shortlisted statuses and 1 verified).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend regression test added: TestPublicProfile::test_public_profile_returns_all_submissions_with_category in /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py. It asserts 'Submitted' status appears, all required fields exist (challenge_category included), and ordering is submitted_at desc. Demo student id is hardcoded in that test; if DB is reseeded ensure the demo user still has at least one 'Submitted' submission.
rca of the issue: Previous code in /api/profile/{student_id} added a Mongo filter {'$or':[{'status':{'$in':[...]}},{'verified':True}]} on submissions which hid the demo student's 'Submitted' rows. Fix removed the filter so the query is simply {'student_id': student_id} sorted by submitted_at desc; submissions are then enriched with challenge_category by joining the challenges collection. Frontend was already laid out with the required testids and conditional verified badge. Verified end-to-end via backend pytest + Playwright DOM checks.
